title: Running a Single PNU Analysis
text: Running PNU analysis real CDM database requires three steps getDbPnuData(): define cohorts Capr, generate CohortGenerator, connect load. Everything Step 2 onwards identical simulated-data workflow . example implements PNU study comparing GLP-1 receptor agonists (tirzepatide semaglutide — treatment , reference) bariatric surgery (treatment B, switcher event). Patients must 18 older cohort entry. GLP-1 RA cohort combines tirzepatide (concept 779705) semaglutide (concept 793143) single concept set, patient enters cohort first dispensing either agent exits 45-day gap supply occurs. 45-day persistence window accommodates monthly injectable formulations. bariatric surgery cohort defined single procedure concept (4326683) exits end patient’s observation period, since index date one-time operative event. GLP-1 RA cohort reference treatment (targetCohortId = 1), bariatric surgery cohort marks switcher index dates (comparatorCohortId = 2). Exclude GLP-1 RA concept IDs descendants covariates propensity model condition exposure .
code: connectionDetails <- DatabaseConnector::createConnectionDetails(   dbms     = "postgresql",   server   = "myserver/mydb",   user     = Sys.getenv("DB_USER"),   password = Sys.getenv("DB_PASSWORD") )  cdmDatabaseSchema    <- "cdm" cohortDatabaseSchema <- "results" cohortTable          <- "pnu_cohorts" library(Capr)  # --- Treatment A: GLP-1 receptor agonists (composite) -----------------------  glp1ra <- cs(   descendants(779705L),   # tirzepatide   descendants(793143L),   # semaglutide   name = "GLP-1 receptor agonists" )  glp1raCohort <- cohort(   entry = entry(     drugExposure(glp1ra, age(gte(18L))),     primaryCriteriaLimit = "First"   ),   exit = exit(     endStrategy = drugExit(glp1ra,                            persistenceWindow  = 45L,                            surveillanceWindow = 0L)   ) )  # --- Treatment B: bariatric operative procedure -----------------------------  bariatricCs <- cs(   descendants(4326683L),   name = "Bariatric operative procedure" )  bariatricCohort <- cohort(   entry = entry(     procedure(bariatricCs, age(gte(18L))),     primaryCriteriaLimit = "First"   ),   exit = exit(     endStrategy = observationExit()   ) )  # Cohort IDs are assigned in order: 1 = GLP-1 RA, 2 = bariatric surgery exposureCohorts <- makeCohortSet(glp1raCohort, bariatricCohort) library(CohortGenerator)  cohortTableNames <- getCohortTableNames(cohortTable = cohortTable)  createCohortTables(   connectionDetails    = connectionDetails,   cohortDatabaseSchema = cohortDatabaseSchema,   cohortTableNames     = cohortTableNames )  generateCohortSet(   connectionDetails    = connectionDetails,   cdmDatabaseSchema    = cdmDatabaseSchema,   cohortDatabaseSchema = cohortDatabaseSchema,   cohortTableNames     = cohortTableNames,   cohortDefinitionSet  = exposureCohorts )  # Verify cohort counts sql <- "SELECT cohort_definition_id, COUNT(*) AS n         FROM @cohortDatabaseSchema.@cohortTable         GROUP BY cohort_definition_id" DatabaseConnector::renderTranslateQuerySql(   connection           = DatabaseConnector::connect(connectionDetails),   sql                  = sql,   cohortDatabaseSchema = cohortDatabaseSchema,   cohortTable          = cohortTable ) covariateSettings <- FeatureExtraction::createDefaultCovariateSettings(   excludedCovariateConceptIds   = c(779705L, 793143L),   addDescendantsToExclude       = TRUE )  pnuCohortArgs <- createPnuCohortArgs(   targetCohortId     = 1L,   # GLP-1 RA (reference treatment A)   comparatorCohortId = 2L,   # bariatric surgery (switcher / treatment B)   outcomeCohortId    = 3L    # define and generate separately )  pnuData <- getDbPnuData(   connectionDetails    = connectionDetails,   cdmDatabaseSchema    = cdmDatabaseSchema,   cohortDatabaseSchema = cohortDatabaseSchema,   cohortTable          = cohortTable,   pnuCohortArgs        = pnuCohortArgs,   covariateSettings    = covariateSettings )  # Then proceed with Steps 2–7 or runPnuAnalyses() above

what: Simulate a PnuData object with a known treatment effect — simulatePnuData
title: Simulate a PnuData object with a known treatment effect — simulatePnuData
text: Generates [PnuData] object whose treatment effect, covariate structure, outcome rates determined `simulationArgs`. random draws made `withr::with_seed()` caller's RNG state restored exit. **Outcome model** Outcome times follow Exp(lambda) `lambda = lambda0 * exp(logRr * treatment)` per day, `lambda0` chosen P(event `followUpDays` | comparator) = `outcomeBaseRate`. **Covariate model** `nCovariates` binary covariates drawn independently. P(X = 1 | comparator) = `prevalenceBase`; P(X = 1 | switcher) = min(1, `prevalenceBase + prevalenceDiff`). Covariates predict treatment assignment , crude outcome rate ratio equals `exp(logRr)` asymptotically.
